## What to build

Build the Frontier Reviewer decision path and tiered repair policy. Review outcomes should be evidence-based and should update the Issue Slice, Local Agent session, and mission summary consistently.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Review outcomes support Approved, Approved with limitations, Needs repair, Needs human review, and Rejected.
- [x] Missing or invalid evidence prevents Approved outcomes.
- [x] First rejection routes repair to the same Local Agent.
- [x] Second rejection routes repair to a fresh Local Agent.
- [x] Repeated architecture failure routes back to Frontier Architect revision.
- [x] Critical, security, or merge-risk failure escalates to the user.
source_issue.title: 06 — Frontier Review and Repair Policy

behavior: Review risk is an optional typed reviewer classification; absence is unrecorded, not verified safe.
Risk-bearing Rejected, Needs repair or Needs human review decisions automatically persist NeedsHumanReview.
Approving decisions cannot carry unresolved risk.
Held work blocks dependent dispatch, direct approval/run/repair and new sibling repair proposals.
A later explicit human review without risk resolves the hold; original successful check and criterion requirements remain.
Activity, task status/readiness and evidence show escalation while retaining original outcome.
Exact older-store backups, unclassified legacy review/retry and risk downgrade refusal preserve migration truth.

validation.real_worker_risk_matrix: All three risk classes, successful and failed runs, three nonapproval outcomes, reopen/exact retry/conflict/bypass refusal, explicit resolution and dependent dispatch
